versions.changelog:
Initial release of PDF-to-Word conversion skill for Windows/Foxit (Chinese):

- Converts PDFs to DOCX by automating Foxit PhantomPDF/PDF Editor via keyboard shortcuts.
- Automatically detects Foxit installation via multiple methods (common paths and registry).
- Supports custom output directory, force-closing existing Foxit processes, retries, and batch processing.
- Clipboard handling ensures proper output path entry and avoids issues with Chinese filenames.
- Includes verbose/debug mode, error handling, and detailed troubleshooting guide.
- Designed for Windows with Chinese Foxit; includes workflow details and performance tips.
